claims.text: For bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(G=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
Let \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\) and \(m=\binom{a+b}{a}\). Then \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^m\) if and only if \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}(Q\otimes\mathbb Q)=m\).
Under the equivalent rational-full-rank hypothesis, the images of \(G\) form a homogeneous integral basis of \(Q\), and \[ \operatorname{Hilb}_{Q}(z)=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_{z}. \]

Minimality alone does not imply rational full rank: for \(A=\mathbb Z[x]\), \(J=(2x,x^2)\), the irredundant family \(\{2x,x^2\}\) has \(J/A_+J\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\), of rational rank \(1<2\).
A uniform proof that \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}(J_v/A_+J_v)\otimes\mathbb Q=\binom{a+b}{a}\) is not supplied here.
